ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p / FIN11 LEMURLOOT (human2.aspx) webshell drop on MOVEit Transfer (CVE-2023-34362)
ucs.description: Detects the hallmark Cl0p / GRACEFUL SPIDER initial-access tradecraft from the May/June 2023 MOVEit Transfer mass-exploitation campaign: the IIS worker (w3wp.exe) hosting the MOVEit Transfer/DMZ app pool writes the LEMURLOOT ASPX webshell (canonically human2.aspx) or a same-incident App_Web_<random>.dll into the application's wwwroot. The same write-by-w3wp pattern was reused against Cl0p's other MFT targets (GoAnywhere CVE-2023-0669, Cleo CVE-2024-50623/55956) so the pivot generalises beyond MOVEit.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths values(Filesystem.file_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.process_name=w3wp.exe AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEitTransfer\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEit DMZ\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\wwwroot\\*") AND (Filesystem.file_name="human2.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="human.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="App_Web_*.dll") by host Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.action | rename Filesystem.* AS * | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name=w3wp.exe AND Processes.process_name IN (cmd.exe, powershell.exe, pwsh.exe, certutil.exe, bitsadmin.exe) by host Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | rename Processes.* AS * ] | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let MoveItWrites = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\MOVEitTransfer\", @"\MOVEit DMZ\", @"\wwwroot\")
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
| where FileName in~ ("human2.aspx","human.aspx")
     or FileName matches regex @"(?i)^App_Web_[a-z0-9]{8}\.dll$"
     or (FileName endswith ".aspx" and FileName !in~ ("login.aspx","default.aspx","upload.aspx","machine2.aspx"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentFileName;
let MoveItChildProcs = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("MOVEitDMZ","MOVEitTransfer")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","net.exe")
| project ChildTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, ChildImage=FileName, ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
MoveItWrites
| join kind=leftouter MoveItChildProcs on DeviceName
| where isnull(ChildTime) or abs(datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, ChildTime)) <= 60
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let MoveItWrites = ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where ActingProcessName endswith "w3wp.exe"
| where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\MOVEitTransfer\", @"\MOVEit DMZ\", @"\wwwroot\")
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
| where TargetFileName in~ ("human2.aspx","human.aspx")
     or TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)^App_Web_[a-z0-9]{8}\.dll$"
     or (TargetFileName endswith ".aspx" and TargetFileName !in~ ("login.aspx","default.aspx","upload.aspx","machine2.aspx"))
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, TargetFileName, TargetFilePath, TargetFileSHA256;
let MoveItChildProcs = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\w3wp.exe"
| where NewProcessName has_any ("\\cmd.exe","\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\certutil.exe","\\bitsadmin.exe","\\curl.exe","\\net.exe")
| project ChildTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, ChildImage=NewProcessName, ChildCmd=CommandLine;
MoveItWrites
| join kind=leftouter MoveItChildProcs on $left.DvcHostname == $right.Computer
| where isnull(ChildTime) or abs(datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, ChildTime)) <= 60
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Cl0p LEMURLOOT Webshell Drop on MOVEit Transfer by IIS Worker
id: 8f3a9c14-2d7b-4f1e-9c08-b1d6f0e87d2a
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of the LEMURLOOT ASPX webshell (human2.aspx / App_Web_<random>.dll) by w3wp.exe under MOVEit Transfer install path - hallmark of the Cl0p (FIN11 / GRACEFUL SPIDER / TA505) CVE-2023-34362 mass-exploitation campaign.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-158a
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/zero-day-moveit-data-theft
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/05
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.g0092
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\MOVEitTransfer\'
      - '\MOVEit DMZ\'
      - '\wwwroot\'
  selection_human2:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\human2.aspx'
      - '\human.aspx'
  selection_appweb:
    TargetFilename|re: '(?i)\\App_Web_[a-z0-9]{8}\.dll$'
  condition: selection_proc and selection_path and (selection_human2 or selection_appweb)
falsepositives:
  - Vendor hotfix / patch installations - verify SHA256 against Progress MOVEit release manifest before dismissing
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @Image:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE) (@TargetFilename:(*\\MOVEitTransfer\\* OR *\\MOVEit\ DMZ\\* OR *\\wwwroot\\*)) (@TargetFilename:(*\\human2.aspx OR *\\human.aspx OR *\\App_Web_*.dll OR *\\App_Web_*.DLL))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten ContextImageFileName=/w3wp\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)\\\\(MOVEitTransfer|MOVEit DMZ|wwwroot)\\\\", field=TargetFileName)
| regex("(?i)(\\\\human2?\\.aspx$|\\\\App_Web_[a-z0-9]{8}\\.dll$)", field=TargetFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName], function=count())
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/w3wp\.exe$/i | ImageFileName=/(cmd|powershell|pwsh|certutil|bitsadmin|curl|net)\.exe$/i}, field=aid, include=[ImageFileName, CommandLine], mode=left)

ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p ransomware deployment: shadow-copy wipe + .Clop/.C_L0P mass rename + ClopReadMe.txt drop on the same host
ucs.description: Detects the final-stage Cl0p ransomware execution chain - vssadmin/wmic shadowcopy deletion, bulk file renames to Cl0p's distinctive .Clop / .Cl0p / .C_L0P / .C_L_0_P / .CIIp extensions, and the ClopReadMe.txt (or Cl0pReadMe.txt / README_README.txt) ransom-note drop, all on the same endpoint within a 30-minute window. The extension set and ransom-note filename are unique fingerprints of the Cl0p / TA505 / Spandex Tempest payload and have remained stable across the FlawedAmmyy → Get2/SDBbot → Truebot → Cl0p chain since 2019.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as shadowTime values(Processes.process) as shadowCmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*") by host Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name | rename Processes.* AS * | convert ctime(shadowTime) | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true count as encryptedCount min(_time) as firstEncrypt max(_time) as lastEncrypt values(Filesystem.file_path) as samplePaths from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action="renamed" AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.Clop" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.Cl0p" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.C_L_0_P" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.C_L0P" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.CIIp") by host Filesystem.process_name | rename Filesystem.* AS * | where encryptedCount >= 25 | convert ctime(firstEncrypt) ctime(lastEncrypt)] | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as noteTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as notePath from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name IN ("ClopReadMe.txt","Cl0pReadMe.txt","README_README.txt","CIIpReadMe.txt") by host Filesystem.process_name | rename Filesystem.* AS * | convert ctime(noteTime)] | table host shadowTime shadowCmd firstEncrypt lastEncrypt encryptedCount samplePaths noteTime notePath
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ShadowKill = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" and ProcessCommandLine has "no")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project ShadowTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, ShadowImage=FileName, ShadowCmd=ProcessCommandLine, ShadowParent=InitiatingProcessFileName, ShadowUser=AccountName;
let RansomNote = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName in~ ("ClopReadMe.txt","Cl0pReadMe.txt","README_README.txt","CIIpReadMe.txt","C_L_0_P_ReadMe.txt")
| project NoteTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, NoteName=FileName, NotePath=FolderPath, NoteWriter=InitiatingProcessFileName, NoteWriterCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let Encryptions = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActionType in ("FileRenamed","FileCreated")
| where FileName matches regex @"(?i)\.(Clop|Cl0p|C_L_0_P|C_L0P|CIIp|CllP)$"
| summarize EncryptedCount=count(), FirstEncrypt=min(Timestamp), LastEncrypt=max(Timestamp), SampleFile=any(FolderPath), Encryptor=any(InitiatingProcessFileName), EncryptorHash=any(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
         by DeviceName
| where EncryptedCount >= 25;   // 25 = empirical lower bound for ransomware sweep vs. user-driven .Clop rename
ShadowKill
| join kind=inner Encryptions on DeviceName
| where ShadowTime between (FirstEncrypt - 30m .. LastEncrypt + 30m)
| join kind=inner RansomNote on DeviceName
| where NoteTime between (FirstEncrypt - 30m .. LastEncrypt + 30m)
| project DeviceName, ShadowTime, ShadowCmd, FirstEncrypt, LastEncrypt, EncryptedCount, Encryptor, EncryptorHash, NoteTime, NotePath, NoteName, NoteWriter
| order by ShadowTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ShadowKill = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "shadows")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has "recoveryenabled" and CommandLine has "no")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project ShadowTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, ShadowImage=NewProcessName, ShadowCmd=CommandLine, ShadowParent=ParentProcessName, ShadowUser=SubjectUserName;
let RansomNote = ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where TargetFileName in~ ("ClopReadMe.txt","Cl0pReadMe.txt","README_README.txt","CIIpReadMe.txt","C_L_0_P_ReadMe.txt")
| project NoteTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, NoteName=TargetFileName, NotePath=TargetFilePath, NoteWriter=ActingProcessName;
let Encryptions = ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventType in ("FileRenamed","FileCreated")
| where TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)\.(Clop|Cl0p|C_L_0_P|C_L0P|CIIp|CllP)$"
| summarize EncryptedCount=count(), FirstEncrypt=min(TimeGenerated), LastEncrypt=max(TimeGenerated), SampleFile=any(TargetFilePath), Encryptor=any(ActingProcessName), EncryptorHash=any(TargetFileSHA256)
         by DvcHostname
| where EncryptedCount >= 25;   // 25 = empirical sweep threshold (P95 daily file-rename bursts < 10)
ShadowKill
| join kind=inner Encryptions on $left.Computer == $right.DvcHostname
| where ShadowTime between (FirstEncrypt - 30m .. LastEncrypt + 30m)
| join kind=inner RansomNote on $left.Computer == $right.DvcHostname
| where NoteTime between (FirstEncrypt - 30m .. LastEncrypt + 30m)
| project Computer, ShadowTime, ShadowCmd, FirstEncrypt, LastEncrypt, EncryptedCount, Encryptor, NoteTime, NotePath, NoteName
| order by ShadowTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE OR *\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE)) (@CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"recoveryenabled no"*)) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(vssadmin|wmic|bcdedit)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(delete\\s+shadows|shadowcopy\\s+delete|recoveryenabled\\s+no)", field=CommandLine)
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten | regex("(?i)\\\\(Cl0p|Clop|CIIp|C_L_0_P)ReadMe\\.txt$", field=TargetFileName)}, field=aid, include=[TargetFileName])
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten | regex("(?i)\\.(Clop|Cl0p|C_L_0_P|C_L0P|CIIp)$", field=TargetFileName) | groupBy([aid], function=count(as=encCount)) | encCount >= 25}, field=aid, include=[encCount])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, TargetFileName, encCount], function=count())
ucs.rationale: The .Cl0p / .Clop / .C_L_0_P / .CIIp encrypted-file suffix family and the ClopReadMe.txt note filename are payload-unique to TA505's Cl0p variant and have not been adopted by other ransomware crews (BitDefender, NCC, Trend research all confirm).
